description: This file defines a library of functions for managing git merge and diff tools, including configuration, invocation, and utility functions for handling various merge tool options and environment detection.

methods.name: mode_ok
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is either diff or merge based on TOOL_MODE.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if a specified merge tool path is available in the system.

methods.name: list_config_tools
methods.description: Lists configuration-defined tools for a given section.

methods.name: show_tool_names
methods.description: Displays available tools, optionally filtered by condition.

methods.name: diff_mode
methods.description: Returns true if current TOOL_MODE is set to diff.

methods.name: merge_mode
methods.description: Returns true if current TOOL_MODE is set to merge.

methods.name: get_gui_default
methods.description: Determines if the GUI mode should be used by default, based on environment and config.

methods.name: gui_mode
methods.description: Returns true if the GUI mode is enabled.

methods.name: translate_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the merge tool, possibly translating or defaulting.

methods.name: check_unchanged
methods.description: Checks whether the merge result is unchanged, verifying success.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Verifies if a specified tool is valid and usable.

methods.name: setup_user_tool
methods.description: Sets up a user-defined tool for merging or diffing.

methods.name: setup_tool
methods.description: Initializes tool-specific functions and configuration.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command line for a specified merge or diff tool.

methods.name: trust_exit_code
methods.description: Determines if the merge tool's exit code can be trusted.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Prepares the environment for using a specific merge tool.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Runs the merge tool with the given arguments.

methods.name: run_diff_cmd
methods.description: Executes a diff command using the specified tool.

methods.name: run_merge_cmd
methods.description: Executes a merge command and checks for success.

methods.name: list_merge_tool_candidates
methods.description: Provides a list of candidate merge tools based on environment.

methods.name: show_tool_help
methods.description: Displays help information about available tools.

methods.name: guess_merge_tool
methods.description: Attempts to guess an appropriate merge tool when none is configured.

methods.name: get_configured_merge_tool
methods.description: Retrieves the merge tool configured in git config.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Determines the filesystem path to the specified merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Main function to obtain the merge tool to use, possibly guessing if not configured.

methods.name: mergetool_find_win32_cmd
methods.description: Finds Windows-specific executable commands for merge tools.
